chapter: England, later career and closing thoughts
title: Regret that her records are out of print
summary: None of her records are being released, which costs her income; she had never planned to be a singer.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: The thing that I regret today is the fact that none of the record companies, they're not releasing any of my material, any of these things that I did, and it hurts a little bit because this is one of the ways that you make money in the business, you know. You're not just in it for your health or because you like to do it. I enjoy it. I love what I do. I love my work and I'm extremely grateful that my career turned out like it did, because as I say, I really did not concentrate on being a singer. This was far from my mind. I wanted to be an arranger.
